What about flowers and herbs?

Flowers and herbs aren't an extra — they're full residents of your vegetable garden.

What is it?

A chaos garden makes little distinction between vegetables, flowers and herbs. Everything is allowed to grow together.

Why does it work?

  • Flowers attract pollinators.
  • Flowering herbs attract lots of insects.
  • They increase diversity and create more combination possibilities.
  • The garden simply becomes more beautiful.

How do you apply it?

  • Plant flowers among your vegetables.
  • Use herbs and let them flower.
  • Let some vegetables go to flower.
  • Experiment with edible flowers.

Nuance

Just a few flowers or herbs already make a big difference.
